(Electronics and Communication, Visvesvaraya Technological University), M.Tech (VLSI Design and Embedded Systems, Visvesvaraya Technological University), Ph.D. (Visvesvaraya Technological University) Linkedin Link Dr. Suma Sannamani is an Assistant Professor in the BCA Department with 8.6 years of teaching experience. With extensive experience in an engineering college, she serves as the Convenor of the Consultancy Cell and is an active Innovation Ambassador. Passionate about student development, she mentors learners and consistently keeps herself updated with emerging technologies as a dedicated lifelong learner.
